title: Ground State Energy
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly identify that the ground state energy E_0 is hbar omega / 2.

title: Alpha Value
description: Essential Criteria: The student must derive the correct value of alpha as m omega / (2 hbar).

title: First Excited State
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly express the non-normalized wave function of the first excited state as |1> = sqrt(2m omega / hbar) x exp(-m omega / (2 hbar) x^2).

title: 3D Wave Function
description: Important Criteria: The student must provide the correct form of the wave functions for the degenerate first excited state in polar coordinates.

title: Uncertainty Principle
description: Important Criteria: The student must demonstrate understanding of the uncertainty principle and its application to the ground state energy.

title: Sign Mistakes
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid sign mistakes when calculating momentum and position uncertainties.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must ensure that all derived quantities, such as alpha, have consistent units.

title: Normalization Check
description: Optional Criteria: The student may check the normalization of the wave functions derived.

title: Alternative Methods
description: Optional Criteria: The student may mention alternative methods to derive the wave functions without solving differential equations.
